works.title: Where the words were
works.medium: Generated digital image in a stained-glass idiom
works.description: Landry burns her diary to help start the fire that shelters her and her companions on the mountain. Kalen grieves for the record of her father and brothers; Landry tells him it is no longer all she has of them. works.title: Navidad’s memories
works.medium: Twelve generated digital paintings, presented as one ordered montage
works.description: Tom’s account of Navidad’s life moves through her mother’s care and their separation, Mouse’s companionship, and the room the boy makes for her. The sequence follows the return, the girl’s arrival, the rockfall, care on the icy wall, moonlit wings, rest, and a descent weighed down by the boy’s growing burden. These images visualize Tom’s telling, preserving its shifts between memory and metaphor.
works.attribution: Isaac’s personal collection
works.credit: Generated images, selected and sequenced by Isaac.
works.note: Imagined by the curator as a cohesive montage of Navidad’s life. Read the twelve images in order, left to right across each row. The twelve-part division, titles, character designs, settings and painted wings are artistic choices, not a claim that the book describes twelve exhibition paintings or that a horse literally grows wings. The nearby companion, The Wings Were Always There, revisits related moments without extending the sequence.
works.alt: A mare nuzzles a black foal finding its feet in a sunny field.
